migration_flags.summary: account_stock_expense_id and account_stock_income_id are NOT on res.company in v19. account_stock_expense_id lives on account.account (stock_account/models/account_account.py:10). account_stock_income_id does not exist in v19 community at all.
parent_id cannot be changed after company creation. write() raises UserError on any attempt. Migration must set the company hierarchy correctly at create time only.
Currency change is blocked by the account module once any journal entry lines exist for the root company or its branches.
hard_lock_date is a new field in v19 (not present in v16/v17). It is irreversible once set — cannot be removed or decreased. Migration must not populate this field unless explicitly intended.
account_storno is auto-computed from account_fiscal_country_id. Thailand is not in STORNO_MANDATORY_COUNTRIES (BA,CN,CZ,HR,PL,RO,RS,RU,SI,SK,UA). Thai companies have storno off by default.
paperformat_id remains on base/models/res_company.py:87 in v19. It was NOT moved to a different location.
report_footer (Html field) remains on base/models/res_company.py:59 in v19. It was NOT removed.

New account.lock_exception model in v19 enables per-user soft lock date overrides. user_*_lock_date computed fields are context-dependent and exception-aware. Migration data that relied on simple lock_date fields must account for this new exception mechanism.
Thai l10n chart template sets tax_exigibility=True (cash basis) automatically when loaded. Thai companies have cash basis enabled as a default. Also sets 12 other company account defaults.
_check_tax_return_configuration is deprecated (no-op stub, marked for removal in master). Do not call from migration code.
